title: Binary multiplication modulo an irreducible polynomial
statement: Let $\ell>0$, and let a certified binary field implementation of degree $\ell$ specify an irreducible monic polynomial over $\mathbb{F}_2$ of the form $X^\ell+\sum_{i=0}^{\ell-1}m_iX^i$. For binary vectors $x,y\in\mathbb{F}_2^\ell$, their modular product is the vector returned as the first component of the multiplication state after $\ell$ steps using that implementation.
hypotheses_covered: A degree-$\ell$ binary modulus with irreducibility certificate
caveat: The referenced multiplication-state construction is not included, so its computation cannot be described more explicitly from the supplied statement.
